title: Stylebook Outfit Repeat Gap
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:wardrobe category=* last_worn_epoch=* worn_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((worn_epoch-last_worn_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by category
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures outfit repeat gap by category for wardrobe rotation.
value: Lag tracking shows which category create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside wardrobe rotation.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `outfit repeat gap` on `style:wardrobe` events and aggregate them by `category`.
visualization: Table of category with average and worst outfit repeat gap.
grandmaExplanation: It surfaces how long things take for each category so you can see where wardrobe rotation slows down.
